name: TG-FileStreamBot
description: Turn any Telegram file into an instant direct download / streaming link.

BIN_CHANNEL.description: Channel ID where the bot forwards & stores files

FQDN.description: Your domain name, used for link generation (leave empty to auto-use the heroku app URL)

HAS_SSL.description: Set True to generate https:// links

NO_PORT.description: Set True to hide the port from generated links

PORT.description: Port the web server listens on

ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user IDs/usernames allowed to use the bot. Leave empty for public access

HASH_LENGTH.description: Length of the hash in generated URLs (6-63)

SLEEP_THRESHOLD.description: Seconds to sleep on flood wait before retrying

WORKERS.description: Max concurrent workers for handling updates

KEEP_ALIVE.description: Ping self every PING_INTERVAL seconds — handy for free tiers

USE_SESSION_FILE.description: Use session files instead of in-memory SQLite (keep False on Heroku/ephemeral disk)

DATABASE_URI.description: MongoDB connection string. Leave empty to disable DB features

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram user ID — required for /stats and /broadcast

FSUB_CHANNEL.description: Channel username/ID users must join before using the bot. Leave empty to disable
